description: 双兵对峙②：王兵协同 — 白王占据有利位置，g/h联兵配合推进

intro.popup_en: The white king on f4 has penetrated farther into Black's position than the black king on d3. Advance the connected g- and h-pawns with the king's support.
intro.popup: 💡 王兵协同：白王（f4）已在黑方阵地中，比黑王（d3）更靠近双兵战场。白方推进 g/h 联兵，白王保驾护航。

outro.popup_en: White wins. The king leads the connected pawns forward, and Black cannot stop both advancing fronts.
outro.popup: ✅ 结论：白胜！ 白王在前，联兵跟进，黑方无法同时阻挡两路推进。

moves.popup_en: 1. g4: the connected pawns advance together.
moves.popup: 1.g4 — 联兵出动！两兵齐头并进。

moves.popup_en: 1...h5: Black tries to block the h-pawn.
moves.popup: 1...h5 — 黑兵试图阻挡 h 路推进。

moves.popup_en: 2. g5: the g-pawn keeps moving forward.
2...Ke4: the black king races to catch up.
3. h4: the h-pawn joins the advance, creating two threats.
3...hxg5: the black pawn captures the g-pawn, but the h-pawn remains.
moves.popup: 3...h×g5 — 黑兵吃掉 g5，但 h 兵仍在。

moves.popup_en: 4. hxg5: the white h-pawn recaptures. The resulting king-and-pawn ending is clearly winning.
moves.popup: 4.h×g5 — 白 h 兵回吃，局面清晰，白王+g5 兵胜。
